title: NBA plans AI system for automatic out-of-bounds calls
summary: NBA commissioner Adam Silver announced plans to implement an AI-powered automated officiating system for out-of-bounds calls, using cameras positioned around the court to track possession. The system is inspired by Hawk-Eye technology already used in tennis for line calls, aiming to improve accuracy and reduce disputed calls.
problem_solved: Reduces controversial and disputed out-of-bounds calls in NBA games through automated, precise tracking.
why_valuable: Enhances officiating accuracy and fairness in professional basketball by leveraging proven tracking technology from other sports.
